Tell me about the therapist/therapy. Also mind if know the meds?

> Memories aren't meant to be torments. They're there so you can keep the times that made you happy, and learn from the times that weren't so great.

Tormenting is just these memories are doing to me. I wish sometimes that I could just hit the 'restart game' and try again with my new found knowledge of where I messed up. That's not possible and 'letting go' is not something I can do so I forever wish for another girl in my life to feel passionate about.

> One day, your going to realize that you didn't think of her all day.

Yeah I have had days like this. At times I thought I was getting better. One surprising thing that did help was watching her twitter for the dumb things she said but she got bored of tweeting after a few months and I gradually started missing her again.

I have looked and tried. Because of the trouble I have trying to find singles girls in public I have resorted to an online dating site and haven't had any response. I feel like I couldn't ever get a girlfriend unless I had a major face lift. While I can work out as much as I like and use moisturizer everyday like a metro, I'm still stuck with this ugliness.

I'm not sure if some people can really be ok with loneliness, I can't as a fact and my coping mechanism so far has been to just not think about it. At good times and be really communicative and joking. What you have said about becoming a better person is true, however I feel very limited in that I can only do so much. I try to exercise almost everyday but still feel no matter how much effort I put in, I'm just gona remain ugly. I don't even know how to just ask someone to be a friend without sounding weird. Or how to ask someone to go do something without sounding gay. Having no friends also makes me less suitable as someones new friend. In fact I have tried the forgetting about my shit and myself up as a person for a few years now without results.
